blocks.text: Key specs & highlights: Engine: SKYACTIV‑G 2.5 DOHC 4‑cyl (2,488 cc). Power: 187 hp @ 6,000 rpm; Torque: 186 lb‑ft @ 4,000 rpm. EPA (AWD) 24 city / 30 hwy mpg. Cargo (seats up/down): 33.7 / 66.5 cu ft. Wheel size: 19-inch alloy. Notable features: 12.9" touchscreen, wireless Apple CarPlay/Android Auto, Google built‑in, Mazda Radar Cruise Control, Blind Spot Monitoring, Rear Power Liftgate, heated front seats & steering wheel. (All items from Mazda product pages.)
